articles.title: 美联航不让AI代理订机票
articles.summary: 美联航表示出于隐私和监管顾虑，不允许个人AI助手代订机票，称目前实际尝试的人还很少。
articles.why: 这是AI代理进入日常生活时遇到的真实阻力，说明“让AI帮你办事”还没那么顺，隐私和规则是坎。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 想想：如果AI帮你订票，你愿意把个人信息交给它吗？
articles.source_title: United won’t let your AI agent book your flight

articles.title: 谷歌实验工具Tabletop可搭协作小应用
articles.summary: 谷歌推出实验性AI工具Tabletop，用户用自然语言描述就能生成自定义的协作小工具，目前需申请等待名单。
articles.why: 这类“说话就能做小工具”的实验，代表AI工具正从聊天走向帮你动手搭东西，新手可以关注它是否开放。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注点：不用写代码，描述需求就能生成小工具，这靠谱吗？
articles.source_title: Google’s Tabletop AI experiment lets you build custom collaboration apps

articles.title: 谷歌AlphaGenome 2聚焦疾病细胞根源
articles.summary: 谷歌DeepMind发布AlphaGenome 2模型，帮科学家更细地看DNA变化如何影响不同细胞，为疾病研究提供线索。
articles.why: 这是AI在生物医学领域的进展，离日常使用较远，但说明AI正被用来解决科研难题，值得知道方向。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 了解即可：AI不只聊天，还在帮科学家研究基因和疾病。
articles.source_title: Google’s AlphaGenome 2 zooms in on the cellular roots of disease

articles.title: Adobe实验：照片变可逛3D场景
articles.summary: Adobe在Max大会展示实验功能，可把图片变成可探索的3D场景、通过对话设计AI角色，以及像复制粘贴一样修图。
articles.why: 对内容创作者来说，这类实验预示修图和做场景会越来越省事，但仍是实验阶段，别当成现成产品。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 观察点：图片变3D、对话做角色，哪些会真正落地到常用软件？
articles.source_title: Adobe’s AI experiments let you walk around in photos and interview your characters

articles.title: 百度内部活跃智能体一年增6倍
articles.summary: 李彦宏在百度世界大会透露，百度内部每天活跃智能体从0.5万增至3.7万，每周有效任务完成数从8.4万增至超100万。
articles.why: 大公司内部大规模用智能体干活，说明“AI代理”正从演示走向实际办公，普通用户可留意类似工具。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以想：智能体帮公司干活，和个人用AI助手有什么不同？
articles.source_title: 李彦宏：百度内部每天的活跃智能体数一年内增至 3.7 万，涨了 6 倍多

articles.title: Claude API可中途调节“努力程度”
articles.summary: Anthropic为Claude API新增Beta功能，开发者可在对话中途调整模型投入的effort档位，在回答充分度、速度和成本间取舍。
articles.why: 这影响开发者怎么用AI控制成本和速度，普通用户暂时用不到，但能理解AI服务背后有“用力多少”的开关。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 知道有这回事：AI回答可以按任务调“用力档”，不是越用力越好。
articles.source_title: Claude API 新增调节 effort 能力：让 AI 按任务使劲，从闲聊转复杂分析可中途“换挡”

articles.title: 大模型厂商天猫双11打5折
articles.summary: 量子位报道，智谱、MiniMax、千问办公、阿里云、Qoder等大模型厂商在天猫双11期间打5折。
articles.why: AI服务开始像普通商品一样打折促销，说明竞争激烈，对想试用AI工具的新手可能意味着更低的尝试成本。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以留意：AI工具打折时，先想清楚自己是否真的需要再买。
articles.source_title: 卷起来了！11月11日，大模型厂商在天猫打5折

items.summary: Weight-space programming, introduced in recent MIT work by Takehi et al., enables a frontier LLM agent to read a network's weights and write a repair. Their GPT-6 Astra agent corrected the reasoning loops of Qwen3.5-0.8B without gradients, using 158 agent turns, 89.7 million tokens, and 50 forward-pass requests. items.title_en: Few-Step Streaming Video Generation via Condition Shifting
items.summary: Few-step sampling reduces the cost of streaming video generation. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) supervises few-step generators with a separate fake-score network, which adds training memory and computation and must track the evolving generator. We extend APEX to streaming video by using condition shifting to estimate the velocity field of the generated distribution within the generator. items.note: 用条件偏移在生成器内部估计速度场，降低少步流式视频生成的训练开销。

items.title_en: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
items.summary: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the world the robot currently faces. items.title_cn: 面向智能体机器人操作的世界上下文学习
items.note: 利用上下文学习让机器人跨场景迁移语义经验，摆脱对训练分布的依赖。

items.title_en: Don't Just Trust Your Memory: Evidence-Linked Memory Reduces Memory-Induced Degradation in LLM Agents
items.summary: External memory enables LLM agents to improve from experience by distilling trajectories of past tasks into concise lessons for new tasks. However, memory can also lead to memory-induced degradation, where an agent fails on tasks it would solve without memory, often because it follows a lesson that is incorrect, or misapplies or misreads a valid one. items.title_cn: 别只信记忆：证据关联记忆减少LLM智能体的记忆诱发退化
items.note: 指出外部记忆可能让智能体误用错误经验，提出关联证据的记忆来缓解退化。

items.title_en: dNaViT: Discrete Codes are General-Purpose Visual Representations
items.summary: Discrete autoregressive modeling, notably through next-token prediction, has become a cornerstone of modern language models. Extending this paradigm to vision allows visual and language models to converge on a unified framework, thereby fostering shared methodology and infrastructure. This work investigates a central question: how far can a finite discrete vocabulary go in representing the richness of the visual world? items.title_cn: dNaViT：离散码是通用视觉表示
items.note: 探索有限离散词表能多好地表示视觉世界，提出原生分辨率离散视觉Transformer。

items.title_en: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
items.summary: Tactile sensing is an indispensable modality for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, a capability that hints at the ultimate frontiers of embodied intelligence. However, commercially available tactile sensors are still at a relatively early stage of development, with each type of sensor offering irreplaceable strengths alongside its own drawbacks. items.title_en: WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence
items.summary: Visual generative models increasingly blur the line between synthesizing observations and simulating environments. Yet visual plausibility alone does not constitute successful world modeling: compelling outputs may lack persistent state, physical dynamics, or causally consistent responses to interactions. items.title_en: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
items.summary: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods. Models may overlook useful tool-returned observations, while poorly grounded actions can limit the evidence available for subsequent distillation. items.title_cn: Reframe：面向智能体视觉推理的观测对齐多教师在线蒸馏
items.note: 把观测状态而非仅输出分布作为对齐对象，改善视觉智能体的工具使用。

items.title_en: Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking
items.summary: Decision models such as Jev have emerged as a highly promising paradigm for LLM agent systems, providing lightweight and reliable categorical reasoning for rapid System One execution. However, existing generation-oriented inference engines fail to support these workloads effectively, suffering from severe prefix recomputation overheads or distorted output probabilities. To address this challenge, we propose Flide, an efficient and exact inference engine that decouples the logical tree structure
items.title_cn: Flide：用精确状态分叉加速决策推理
items.note: 针对决策模型前缀重算开销大，提出解耦逻辑树结构的精确推理引擎。

items.title_en: Confucius4-R2T2: A Stable-Prefix Streaming ASR Model for Real Real-Time Transcription
items.summary: Streaming speech recognition is increasingly consumed by machines, such as translators and voice agents, that act on each token as it appears. A token that is later revised costs wasted work or a wrong action. In this work, we present Confucius4-R2T2 (short for Real Real-Time Transcription), a stable-prefix streaming ASR model that never modifies its earlier output while maintaining high accuracy and low latency. R2T2 is obtained by post-training Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on 1,500 hours of Chinese and Engl
items.title_cn: Confucius4-R2T2：面向真实实时转写的稳定前缀流式ASR模型
items.note: 流式语音识别输出后不再修改，兼顾高准确率与低延迟。

items.title_en: SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
items.summary: We identify a key limitation of existing feed-forward 3DGS methods: Gaussian attributes are typically predicted in a radial-distance-normalized space that canonicalizes a global radial statistic of the reconstructed geometry, while the spacing between neighboring Gaussian centers can still vary substantially across scene scales and camera configurations. This mismatch induces systematic shifts in Gaussian-scale targets, leading to ambiguous supervision. To address this, we propose SplatAnything
items.title_cn: SplatAnything：跨任意场景前馈3DGS的高斯间距归一化
items.note: 指出高斯间距随场景尺度变化导致监督模糊，提出间距归一化方法。

items.title_en: P^2-MOPD: Accelerating Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Parameter Priors
items.summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation consolidates expert capabilities by supervising student-generated trajectories, whereas task arithmetic offers a training-free alternative through linear parameter combinations. We view the linear combination of student and expert parameters as a single differentiable model and propose P^2-MOPD, which jointly optimizes the mixing coefficients and the student weights under the same on-policy distillation objective. Unlike task arithmetic, which stays within th
items.title_cn: P²-MOPD：用参数先验加速多教师在线蒸馏
items.note: 把学生与专家参数的线性组合当作可微模型，联合优化混合系数与权重。

items.title_en: Toward the Era of Agentic Embodied Intelligence
items.summary: Foundation models increasingly guide robot actions, yet sustained autonomy requires efficient control and failure recovery. We introduce A2-MEAS, an embodied multi-agent framework built around code as a scaling interface. Learned correction codes combine corrective language, spatial evidence, execution history, and action proposals. MetaBrain provides training supervision and runtime guidance. A correction encoder and adapter absorb this knowledge into policy weights during training, while fresh
items.title_cn: 迈向智能体具身智能时代
items.note: 提出以代码为扩展接口的具身多智能体框架，兼顾高效控制与失败恢复。

items.title_en: PCBRouteAgent: How Close Are LLM Agents to Becoming PCB Routing Engineers?
items.summary: Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules. Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging. We present PCBRouteAgent, a multimodal PCB routing agent inspired by how human engineers coordinate global strategy with local execution. A Global Routing Planner combines board images and structured electrical and geometric
items.title_cn: PCBRouteAgent：LLM智能体离PCB布线工程师还有多远？
items.note: 用多模态智能体协调全局布线与局部执行，应对复杂电路板布线。

items.title_en: VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding
items.summary: Models for physical AI tasks, such as robotics and autonomous driving, need not reason solely in language. They can use visual plans--points, bounding boxes, and trajectories--to represent spatial goals and anticipate motion. However, autoregressive vision-language models generate these plans one coordinate token at a time, making richer predictions increasingly costly. We introduce VFlash, a method for fast, accurate visual planning through Flash Primitive Decoding. VFlash exploits the known st
items.title_cn: VFlash：通过闪速基元解码实现快速准确的视觉规划
items.note: 利用视觉规划基元的已知结构，加速自回归模型逐坐标生成规划。

items.title_en: From Autonomous Agents to Cognitive Symbionts: Toward AI-Augmented Human Intelligence
items.summary: For a decade, progress in artificial intelligence has been measured by how much a machine can do on its own. Large foundation models now write code and run multistep tasks, and personal agents act on a person's behalf. Yet people still forget what they once knew, miss what they are not looking at, fail to find the right words, and face hard choices without the benefit of their own history, because the machine that could help stands outside the situation. As AI moves into the physical world, atte
items.title_cn: 从自主智能体到认知共生体：迈向AI增强的人类智能
items.note: 主张AI应从独立完成任务转向嵌入情境、增强人的认知能力。

items.title_en: SLA: Scaling Spatial-Language-Action Model via Continual Pre-training
items.summary: Reliable robotic manipulation requires both semantic understanding and precise control in three-dimensional space. However, vision-language-action (VLA) foundations largely inherit visual representations from 2D vision-language pre-training, while spatial supervision is often introduced only during task-specific adaptation. Developing spatial understanding as a transferable foundation-model capability therefore calls for learning from broader robot experience. We present SLA, a Spatial-Language-
items.title_cn: SLA：通过持续预训练扩展空间-语言-动作模型
items.note: 把空间理解作为可迁移基础能力，通过持续预训练从机器人经验中学习。

items.title_en: Harness-S: Learning from Sibling Harnesses for Generalizable Agent Training
items.summary: Harness evolution from a common base exhibits Locality, Complementarity, and Nonstationarity: variants repair different failures, and their utility changes as the policy learns. Rather than seeking a universally superior harness, we introduce Harness-S to selectively rescue failures of a base execution system through sibling harnesses and transfer the resulting capabilities into a single policy that remains effective under the original harness. Directional Harness Evolution develops specialized
items.title_cn: Harness-S：从兄弟执行框架学习可泛化的智能体训练
items.note: 利用不同变体框架互补修复失败，把能力迁移到单一策略中。

items.title_en: Random Is Almost Enough? Stable and Low-Cost Benchmark Compression via BestRand
items.summary: Benchmark compression reduces the often prohibitive time and cost of model evaluation by evaluating models on a small benchmark subset that closely matches full-benchmark results. To quantify estimation error, we derive an accurate analytical approximation to the error distribution when estimating full-benchmark scores from a subset, showing that most subsets yield small errors, while a few produce much larger errors, resulting in a long-tailed distribution. This means random sampling alone can
items.title_cn: 随机几乎够用？用BestRand实现稳定低成本的基准压缩
items.note: 分析子集估计误差的长尾分布，提出更稳定的基准压缩采样方法。

items.title_en: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
items.summary: AI agents are playing an increasingly important role in physics research. However, existing physics benchmarks only evaluate fixed questions, isolated sub-tasks, or paper reproduction with given solutions, and rarely check research quality alongside correctness. We introduce FrontierPhysics, an end-to-end benchmark with 56 tasks made by 42 physicists based on their own research, covering nine domains across theoretical, computational, and experimental physics. Each task requires agents to review
items.title_cn: FrontierPhysics：评估智能体的端到端物理研究能力
items.note: 构建由物理学家出题的端到端基准，同时考察研究质量与正确性。

items.title_en: From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
items.summary: Vision-language-action models are typically built on a simple premise: perception is first compressed by visual encoders, and action reasoning begins only afterwards. Yet manipulation often hinges on precisely the visual signals most vulnerable to this abstraction, e.g., local geometry, boundaries, depth, and subtle state changes. This raises a fundamental question: should action policies inherit a fixed visual endpoint, or directly access evolving visual computation? We introduce NEO-VLA, a str
items.title_cn: 从像素到动作——迈向原生视觉-语言-动作策略
items.note: 质疑固定视觉编码终点，提出让动作策略直接访问演化的视觉计算。

items.title_en: Halley: A Predictive Control Plane for Optical AI Data Center Networks
items.summary: A frontier AI model is trained in an AI data center, on tens of thousands of accelerators joined by a dedicated network, and every training step ends with all of them exchanging data at once. Between racks, that network is optical, and each of its four layers, from lasers to switches, runs a fixed or after-the-fact policy. Lasers sharing an enclosure, cooling, and power can fail together. At a fixed spare ratio, correlated failure provably caps a pool's availability however large it grows. In th
items.title_cn: Halley：光AI数据中心网络的预测性控制平面
items.note: 针对光网络各层固定策略与相关故障问题，提出预测性控制平面。

items.title_en: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
items.summary: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth K and interaction depth T via Pass@(K,T), we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-h
items.title_cn: 多轮强化学习究竟改善了LLM智能体的什么？
items.note: 发现多轮RL收益依赖充足轮次预算，优势集中在错误恢复与长程任务。

items.title_en: GameVerse: A Minute-Scale Gameplay Dataset for Long-Horizon Interactive World Modeling
items.summary: Recent advances in interactive world models have made it possible to generate controllable, dynamic environments from action inputs. Yet current models struggle to maintain coherence beyond roughly one minute of rollout, a limitation rooted not in model capacity but in the scarcity of long-horizon training data. Existing gameplay video datasets typically consist of clips under ten seconds, with captions that describe whole clips in coarse and undifferentiated text, which is insufficient for cont
items.title_cn: GameVerse：面向长程交互世界建模的分钟级游戏数据集
items.note: 指出现有游戏视频片段过短，构建分钟级长程数据支撑世界模型训练。

items.title_en: Route Anything: A Study of Model and Policy Routing for General-Purpose AI Systems
items.summary: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) requires a method that can understand, generate, reason, and act across diverse domains and modalities. Rather than relying on a single model to master every capability, a promising path toward AGI now is to orchestrate a heterogeneous ecosystem of specialized models, tools, and policies (candidates) into a unified AI system. At the heart of this vision lies a fundamental question: how can an AI system dynamically select and coordinate the most capable candi
items.title_cn: Route Anything：通用AI系统模型与策略路由研究
items.note: 研究AI系统如何动态选择并协调异构专用模型、工具与策略。

items.title_en: Words Caught in the Heart: Simulating Person-Specific Expression for Self-Opaque Clients in Psychotherapy
items.summary: Psychotherapy clients may experience distress before they can coherently describe it, and their expression changes with emotion, perceived safety, and trust. Large language model-based client simulators often rely on clinically organized case descriptions, which can encourage responses explaining the client's difficulties more clearly than their current understanding warrants. We propose Pandora, a psychotherapy client simulation framework that models how psychological experience becomes situate
items.title_cn: 心口难言：为心理治疗中自我觉察模糊的来访者模拟个体化表达
items.note: 提出模拟来访者心理体验如何随情绪与信任情境化表达的治疗框架。

items.title_en: Behind Video Generation: Observations and Insights on Multimodal Understanding from Kling
items.summary: Video generation has progressed from isolated clips to coherent short-form audiovisual sequences, and the bottleneck is shifting from rendering to semantic control. This report summarizes the observations and insights on multimodal understanding gained from successive generations of Kling. We argue that generation quality is the projection of multimodal understanding through the entire data--conditioning--alignment--evaluation chain, and we examine this chain module by module. Kling-MLLM, a shar
items.title_cn: 视频生成背后：来自可灵的多元理解观察与洞见
items.note: 认为生成质量是多模态理解在数据、条件、对齐、评估链上的投影。

items.title_en: MoviEdit: Long-form Multi-Shot Video Editing Made Easy
items.summary: Long-form multi-shot video editing requires an intended edit to remain coherent across abrupt changes in scene, viewpoint, and subject appearance, while processing substantially longer visual context than conventional single-shot editors. We introduce MoviEdit, an end-to-end framework for scalable long-form multi-shot video editing that jointly addresses the challenges of data, modeling, and evaluation. To provide cross-shot supervision data at scale, we develop automatic data-generation pipelin
items.title_cn: MoviEdit：让长视频多镜头编辑变简单
items.note: 针对跨镜头一致性难题，从数据、建模与评估三方面构建端到端框架。

items.title_en: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
items.summary: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance on challenging tasks, but their long chain-of-thought often incurs substantial inference costs by continuing to deliberate after sufficient information has been obtained. Existing reasoning compression methods primarily operate on reasoning trajectories, paying less attention to the local decision of whether further reasoning is necessary given the current state. We propose LoCo, a local preference learning method for reasoning compression. LoCo
items.title_cn: 少想一点，局部判断：用于推理压缩的局部偏好学习
items.note: 关注当前状态下是否还需继续推理的局部决策，学习压缩推理链。

items.title_en: Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics
items.summary: Computer graphics is built on code. Large language model (LLM) agents can now generate graphics code and iteratively refine it through various feedback. This capability opens the door to a potentially new paradigm of computer graphics, with graphics algorithms increasingly built around agentic systems to automate progressively complex tasks. Over the past years, research on agentic graphics has expanded rapidly across a diverse range of tasks. This rapid growth makes it increasingly difficult fo
items.title_cn: 智能体计算机图形学进展
items.note: 综述LLM智能体生成并迭代优化图形代码这一新兴研究方向。

items.title_en: Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation
items.summary: Real-time long-video generation requires continuous output with consistent appearance and natural motion. Existing chunk-wise autoregressive methods face challenges in both generation efficiency and long-video quality: serialized denoising and history-cache refresh require two forward passes even with one-step denoising, and longer rollouts can degrade quality and cause camera drift. We propose Wave Forcing (WF), which co-designs generation, training, and execution for continuous video output wi
items.title_cn: 波强制：迈向光速流式视频生成
items.note: 协同设计生成、训练与执行，实现连续视频输出并缓解长程质量退化。

items.title_en: CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
items.summary: Rapid advances in cowork agents are shifting human-AI collaboration toward real-world automation, delivering software, designs, and other artifacts. However, such productivity work demands both high-quality delivery on complex productivity tasks and continued monitoring and decision-making over long horizons, a combination that remains an open challenge. We introduce CoworkOS, a general-purpose harness for long-horizon work that separates task strategy from execution management: the model decide
items.title_cn: CoworkOS：扩展智能体同事以实现真实世界自动化
items.note: 把任务策略与执行管理分离，支撑长程生产力任务的持续监控与决策。

items.title_en: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
items.summary: Video generation is shifting from end-to-end synthesis toward agentic generation, where planning, tool use, and feedback enable coherent, controllable multi-shot videos. In parallel, video world models provide action-conditioned observations and predicted futures, serving as interactive environments for agents. We study their intersection through the agent harness: an executable runtime that constructs context, exposes tools, maintains state, routes feedback, and manages budgets around video mod
items.title_cn: 视频生成遇上智能体执行框架：智能体视频生成、世界建模与递归自我改进
items.note: 通过智能体执行框架研究视频生成与世界模型作为交互环境的交叉。

items.title_en: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
items.summary: Despite recent advances in CUAs, their development remains constrained by the limited diversity, controllability, and reliability of interaction data. Moreover, conventional optimization pipelines lack iterative feedback, while existing recursive improvement approaches often rely on self-generated experiences, limiting ability expansion and yielding diminishing returns. To address these challenges, we introduce CUA-Master, a nested double-loop recursive improvement framework. At the system level
items.title_cn: CUA-Master：通过开放世界递归改进扩展计算机使用智能体
items.note: 针对交互数据有限与自我改进收益递减，提出嵌套双环递归改进框架。

huggingface.models_summary: 这五个模型覆盖文本生成、文生图和图生视频、图生3D，说明热门方向正从纯文字扩展到多模态生成。多数条目描述为空，只能看任务类型，提醒跟进者别只看名字猜能力，要养成查项目页、看模型卡和评测的习惯。对备考AI方向的人，多模态与开源模型迭代快，值得关注任务类型分布和参数规模标注。
huggingface.papers_summary: 这批论文集中在几条主线：智能体（工具使用、多轮强化学习、长程任务与计算机使用）、具身智能与视觉-语言-动作模型、视频与世界模型生成、以及推理压缩和评测基准。新手可记住这些关键词：智能体、强化学习、世界模型、视觉-语言-动作、蒸馏、基准压缩、多模态理解。
